acid-splash.en: Dexterity save; one or two adjacent creatures take 1d6 acid damage, scaling at higher character levels.
acid-splash.zh-CN: 敏捷豁免；一至两个相邻生物失败时受1d6强酸伤害，随角色等级提升。

alarm.en: Ward a door, window, or 20-foot cube for 8 hours; Tiny or larger intruders trigger a mental or audible alarm.
alarm.zh-CN: 守护门窗或20尺立方区域8小时；微型或更大入侵者会触发心灵或响亮警报。

animal-friendship.en: A beast with Intelligence 3 or lower makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 24 hours.
animal-friendship.zh-CN: 智力3或更低的野兽进行感知豁免，失败则被你魅惑24小时。

armor-of-agathys.en: Gain 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour; while they last, melee attackers take 5 cold damage.
armor-of-agathys.zh-CN: 获得5点临时生命值1小时；这些临时生命值存在时，近战攻击者受5点寒冷伤害。

arms-of-hadar.en: Creatures within 10 feet make a Strength save; failure deals 2d6 necrotic damage and prevents reactions until next turn.
arms-of-hadar.zh-CN: 10尺内生物力量豁免；失败受2d6黯蚀伤害，且直到下回合前不能执行反应。

bane.en: Up to three creatures make Charisma saves; failures subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws for up to 1 minute.
bane.zh-CN: 至多三个生物魅力豁免；失败者在至多1分钟内攻击检定和豁免检定减1d4。

blade-ward.en: Until the end of your next turn, gain resistance to weapon bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
blade-ward.zh-CN: 直到你下回合结束，你对武器造成的钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害具有抗性。

bless.en: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for up to 1 minute.
bless.zh-CN: 至多三个生物在至多1分钟内攻击检定和豁免检定加1d4。

burning-hands.en: 15-foot cone; Dexterity save for 3d6 fire damage, half on success, and unattended flammables ignite.
burning-hands.zh-CN: 15尺锥状；敏捷豁免，失败受3d6火焰伤害，成功减半，并点燃无人持用易燃物。

charm-person.en: One humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 hour; hostile targets save with advantage and know afterward.
charm-person.zh-CN: 一个类人生物感知豁免，失败被魅惑1小时；敌对目标豁免有优势，结束后会察觉。

chill-touch.en: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 necrotic damage; target cannot regain hit points until your next turn.
chill-touch.zh-CN: 远程法术攻击造成1d8黯蚀伤害；目标直到你下回合前不能恢复生命值。

chromatic-orb.en: Ranged spell attack for 3d8 acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage of your choice.
chromatic-orb.zh-CN: 远程法术攻击造成3d8伤害，类型可选强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电、毒素或雷鸣。

color-spray.en: 15-foot cone blinds creatures in ascending hit-point order, using a 6d10 hit-point pool until your next turn.
color-spray.zh-CN: 15尺锥状，以6d10生命值池按生命值从低到高影响生物，使其目盲至你下回合。

command.en: A creature that fails a Wisdom save obeys a one-word command on its next turn if it is not directly harmful.
command.zh-CN: 一个生物感知豁免失败时，下回合执行一个不会直接伤害自己的单词命令。

comprehend-languages.en: For 1 hour, understand spoken languages and read touched writing literally; usable as a ritual.
comprehend-languages.zh-CN: 1小时内理解听到的语言，并能按字面理解触碰到的文字；可作为仪式施展。

create-or-destroy-water.en: Create up to 10 gallons of water or destroy the same amount; can also create rain or clear fog in an area.
create-or-destroy-water.zh-CN: 创造或摧毁至多10加仑水；也可在区域内降雨或清除雾气。

cure-wounds.en: Touch a creature to restore 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier hit points; no effect on undead or constructs.
cure-wounds.zh-CN: 触碰生物恢复1d8加施法关键属性调整值的生命值；对不死生物和构装生物无效。

dancing-lights.en: Create up to four dim lights or one vague humanoid glow for up to 1 minute, moving them as a bonus action.
dancing-lights.zh-CN: 创造至多四团微光或一个模糊人形光团，持续至多1分钟，可用附赠动作移动。

detect-evil-and-good.en: For up to 10 minutes, sense nearby aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead, and consecrated or desecrated places.
detect-evil-and-good.zh-CN: 至多10分钟内感知附近异怪、天界、元素、精类、邪魔、不死生物及圣化或亵渎地点。

detect-magic.en: For up to 10 minutes, sense magic within 30 feet and use an action to read its aura and school; ritual.
detect-magic.zh-CN: 至多10分钟内感知30尺内魔法，并可用动作辨识灵光和学派；可作为仪式施展。

detect-poison-and-disease.en: For up to 10 minutes, sense poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet and identify them; ritual.
detect-poison-and-disease.zh-CN: 至多10分钟内感知30尺内毒物、有毒生物和疾病，并辨识其类型；可作为仪式施展。

disguise-self.en: For 1 hour, create an illusory disguise for your body and gear; physical inspection can reveal the mismatch.
disguise-self.zh-CN: 用幻象改变自己和装备外观1小时；实体接触或仔细调查可揭露不一致。

dissonant-whispers.en: One creature makes a Wisdom save; failure deals 3d6 psychic damage and forces it to flee with its reaction.
dissonant-whispers.zh-CN: 一个生物感知豁免；失败受3d6心灵伤害，并用反应远离你。

druidcraft.en: Create a minor nature omen or sensory effect, predict local weather, help a plant bloom, or snuff and light small flames.
druidcraft.zh-CN: 制造微小自然征兆或感官效果、预示天气、促使植物绽放，或点燃/熄灭小火焰。

eldritch-blast.en: Ranged spell attack out to 120 feet for 1d10 force damage; higher levels add more beams.
eldritch-blast.zh-CN: 120尺远程法术攻击，命中造成1d10力场伤害；高等级时增加射线数量。

entangle.en: A 20-foot square becomes difficult terrain; creatures that fail Strength saves are restrained by plants.
entangle.zh-CN: 20尺方形区域变为困难地形；力量豁免失败的生物被植物束缚。

expeditious-retreat.en: Bonus action Dash when cast, then Dash again as a bonus action while concentrating for up to 10 minutes.
expeditious-retreat.zh-CN: 施展时以附赠动作疾走；专注至多10分钟内可继续用附赠动作疾走。

faerie-fire.en: Creatures and objects in a 20-foot cube make Dexterity saves or glow, revealing invisibility and granting advantage to attacks.
faerie-fire.zh-CN: 20尺立方内生物和物件敏捷豁免，失败则发光，显现隐形并使针对它的攻击有优势。

false-life.en: Bolster yourself with 1d4+4 temporary hit points for 1 hour.
false-life.zh-CN: 强化自身，获得1d4+4点临时生命值，持续1小时。

feather-fall.en: Reaction; up to five falling creatures descend slowly for 1 minute and take no falling damage if they land.
feather-fall.zh-CN: 反应施展；至多五个坠落生物缓慢下降1分钟，落地时不受坠落伤害。

find-familiar.en: Ritual summon a familiar spirit in an animal form; it obeys you, scouts, and can deliver touch spells.
find-familiar.zh-CN: 以仪式召唤动物形态的魔宠精魂；它服从你、可侦察，并能传递触及法术。

fire-bolt.en: Ranged spell attack out to 120 feet for 1d10 fire damage; unattended flammable objects ignite, and damage scales.
fire-bolt.zh-CN: 120尺远程法术攻击，命中造成1d10火焰伤害；可点燃无人持用易燃物，伤害随等级提升。

fog-cloud.en: Create a 20-foot-radius heavily obscuring fog for up to 1 hour; wind can disperse it.
fog-cloud.zh-CN: 创造20尺半径的重度遮蔽浓雾，持续至多1小时；强风可驱散。

friends.en: For up to 1 minute, gain advantage on Charisma checks toward one nonhostile creature, which realizes the magic afterward.
friends.zh-CN: 至多1分钟内，对一个非敌对生物的魅力检定有优势；法术结束后对方会察觉魔法影响。

goodberry.en: Create up to ten berries for 24 hours; each heals 1 hit point and nourishes a creature for one day.
goodberry.zh-CN: 创造至多十颗神莓，持续24小时；每颗恢复1点生命值并供给一日营养。

grease.en: A 10-foot square becomes slick difficult terrain; creatures may fall prone on a failed Dexterity save.
grease.zh-CN: 10尺方形区域变为油滑困难地形；生物敏捷豁免失败会倒地。

guidance.en: Touch a willing creature; before the spell ends, it can add 1d4 to one ability check.
guidance.zh-CN: 触碰自愿生物；法术结束前，它可在一次属性检定中加1d4。

guiding-bolt.en: Ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage; the next attack against the target before your next turn has advantage.
guiding-bolt.zh-CN: 远程法术攻击造成4d6光耀伤害；你下回合前针对目标的下一次攻击有优势。

healing-word.en: Bonus action at 60 feet; restore 1d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier hit points, except to undead or constructs.
healing-word.zh-CN: 60尺附赠动作；恢复1d4加施法关键属性调整值的生命值，对不死和构装无效。

hellish-rebuke.en: Reaction when damaged; the attacker makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d10 fire damage, half on success.
hellish-rebuke.zh-CN: 受伤时以反应施展；攻击者敏捷豁免，失败受2d10火焰伤害，成功减半。

heroism.en: A willing creature is immune to frightened and gains temporary hit points each turn while you concentrate.
heroism.zh-CN: 一个自愿生物免疫恐慌，并在你专注期间每回合获得临时生命值。

hex.en: Bonus action curse; your hits deal +1d6 necrotic damage and the target has disadvantage on chosen ability checks.
hex.zh-CN: 附赠动作诅咒目标；你命中它时额外造成1d6黯蚀伤害，并令其一项属性检定有劣势。

identify.en: Touch an object or creature to learn magic properties, attunement, charges, active spells, and similar effects; ritual.
identify.zh-CN: 触碰物件或生物，获知魔法性质、同调、充能、正影响它的法术等；可作为仪式施展。

illusory-script.en: Write a 10-day magical message readable by chosen creatures while others see false or meaningless text; ritual.
illusory-script.zh-CN: 写下持续10日的魔法文字；指定生物能读真文，其他人看到假文或无意义文字；可仪式施展。

inflict-wounds.en: Melee spell attack on a touched creature for 3d10 necrotic damage.
inflict-wounds.zh-CN: 对触及生物发动近战法术攻击，命中造成3d10黯蚀伤害。

jump.en: Touch a creature; its jump distance is tripled for 1 minute.
jump.zh-CN: 触碰一个生物；其跳跃距离在1分钟内变为三倍。

light.en: Touch an object to shed bright and dim light for 1 hour; unwilling holders can avoid it with a Dexterity save.
light.zh-CN: 触碰物件使其发光1小时，提供明亮和微光；非自愿持有者可用敏捷豁免避免。

longstrider.en: Touch a creature to increase its speed by 10 feet for 1 hour.
longstrider.zh-CN: 触碰一个生物，使其速度在1小时内增加10尺。

mage-armor.en: Touch an unarmored willing creature; its base AC becomes 13 plus Dexterity modifier for 8 hours.
mage-armor.zh-CN: 触碰未着甲自愿生物；其基础AC在8小时内变为13加敏捷调整值。

mage-hand.en: Create a spectral hand within 30 feet to manipulate objects, open containers, or carry up to 10 pounds.
mage-hand.zh-CN: 在30尺内创造幽灵手，可操作物件、开关容器，或搬运至多10磅物品。

magic-missile.en: Create three darts that automatically hit visible targets, each dealing 1d4+1 force damage; higher slots add darts.
magic-missile.zh-CN: 创造三枚自动命中可见目标的飞弹，每枚造成1d4+1力场伤害；升环增加飞弹。

mending.en: Repair a single break or tear no larger than 1 foot in an object, leaving no trace of the damage.
mending.zh-CN: 修复物件上一处不超过1尺的破裂或撕口，且不留下损坏痕迹。

message.en: Whisper a magical message to a creature within 120 feet; it hears you and can whisper a reply.
message.zh-CN: 向120尺内生物传递魔法低语；目标能听见，并可低声回复。

minor-illusion.en: Create a sound or a static image in a 5-foot cube for 1 minute; investigation or contact can reveal the illusion.
minor-illusion.zh-CN: 创造声音或5尺立方内静态影像1分钟；调查或实体接触可揭露幻象。

poison-spray.en: A creature within 10 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage, scaling at higher levels.
poison-spray.zh-CN: 10尺内一个生物体质豁免，失败受1d12毒素伤害，随等级提升。

prestidigitation.en: Create small harmless magical tricks such as sensory effects, cleaning, chilling, warming, flavoring, marks, or trinkets.
prestidigitation.zh-CN: 制造小型无害魔法把戏，如感官效果、清洁、冷暖、调味、标记或小饰品。

produce-flame.en: Create a flame in your hand for light, or hurl it as a 30-foot ranged spell attack for 1d8 fire damage.
produce-flame.zh-CN: 在手中创造火焰照明，或以30尺远程法术攻击掷出，造成1d8火焰伤害。

protection-from-evil-and-good.en: Protect a creature from aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead: attacks against it have disadvantage and some control effects are blocked.
protection-from-evil-and-good.zh-CN: 保护一个生物免受异怪、天界、元素、精类、邪魔和不死影响：其攻击有劣势，部分控制效果被阻挡。

purify-food-and-drink.en: Purify nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot radius, removing poison and disease; ritual.
purify-food-and-drink.zh-CN: 净化5尺半径内非魔法食物和饮品，移除毒素和疾病；可作为仪式施展。

ray-of-frost.en: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 cold damage; the target's speed drops by 10 feet until your next turn.
ray-of-frost.zh-CN: 远程法术攻击造成1d8寒冷伤害；目标速度直到你下回合前减少10尺。

ray-of-sickness.en: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 poison damage; target makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until your next turn.
ray-of-sickness.zh-CN: 远程法术攻击造成2d8毒素伤害；目标体质豁免失败则中毒至你下回合。

resistance.en: Touch a willing creature; before the spell ends, it can add 1d4 to one saving throw.
resistance.zh-CN: 触碰自愿生物；法术结束前，它可在一次豁免检定中加1d4。

sacred-flame.en: A target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage; cover does not help against the save.
sacred-flame.zh-CN: 目标敏捷豁免，失败受1d8光耀伤害；掩护不会帮助这次豁免。

sanctuary.en: Bonus action ward a creature; attackers must make a Wisdom save or choose another target, ending if the warded creature attacks or harms foes.
sanctuary.zh-CN: 附赠动作庇护生物；攻击者须感知豁免否则改选目标，受庇护者攻击或伤敌会结束法术。

shield.en: Reaction; gain +5 AC until your next turn and take no damage from magic missile.
shield.zh-CN: 反应施展；直到你下回合前AC+5，并免疫魔法飞弹。

shield-of-faith.en: Bonus action; a creature gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes while you concentrate.
shield-of-faith.zh-CN: 附赠动作；一个生物在你专注至多10分钟内AC+2。

shillelagh.en: Bonus action; a club or quarterstaff becomes magical, uses your spellcasting ability for attacks, and deals d8 damage for 1 minute.
shillelagh.zh-CN: 附赠动作；木棒或长棍变为魔法武器，使用施法关键属性攻击，伤害骰为d8，持续1分钟。

shocking-grasp.en: Melee spell attack for 1d8 lightning damage; advantage against metal armor and the target cannot take reactions.
shocking-grasp.zh-CN: 近战法术攻击造成1d8闪电伤害；对穿金属护甲目标有优势，且目标不能执行反应。

silent-image.en: Create and move a silent visual illusion up to a 15-foot cube; physical interaction or investigation can reveal it.
silent-image.zh-CN: 创造并移动至多15尺立方的无声视觉幻象；实体接触或调查可揭露。

sleep.en: A 20-foot-radius point affects 5d8 hit points of creatures in ascending hit-point order, making them unconscious for 1 minute.
sleep.zh-CN: 20尺半径内按生命值从低到高影响总计5d8生命值的生物，使其昏迷1分钟。

spare-the-dying.en: Touch a living creature at 0 hit points to stabilize it without restoring hit points.
spare-the-dying.zh-CN: 触碰生命值为0的活体生物，使其稳定，但不恢复生命值。

speak-with-animals.en: For 10 minutes, understand and verbally communicate with beasts; ritual.
speak-with-animals.zh-CN: 10分钟内理解野兽并与其口头交流；可作为仪式施展。

tashas-hideous-laughter.en: A creature that fails a Wisdom save falls prone, becomes incapacitated, and laughs until it saves or the spell ends.
tashas-hideous-laughter.zh-CN: 生物感知豁免失败则倒地、陷入失能并大笑，直到豁免成功或法术结束。

tensers-floating-disk.en: Ritual create a 3-foot floating disk that carries up to 500 pounds and follows you for 1 hour.
tensers-floating-disk.zh-CN: 以仪式创造3尺宽浮碟，承载至多500磅并跟随你1小时。

thaumaturgy.en: Create minor divine signs such as a booming voice, trembling ground, altered flames, sounds, or opening doors.
thaumaturgy.zh-CN: 制造小型神迹，如洪亮声音、地面震动、火焰变化、声响或门窗开合。

thorn-whip.en: Melee spell attack out to 30 feet for 1d6 piercing damage and pull Large or smaller targets up to 10 feet.
thorn-whip.zh-CN: 30尺近战法术攻击造成1d6穿刺伤害，并可将大型或更小目标拉近至多10尺。

thunderwave.en: 15-foot cube; Constitution save for 2d8 thunder damage and 10-foot push, half damage and no push on success.
thunderwave.zh-CN: 15尺立方；体质豁免，失败受2d8雷鸣伤害并被推开10尺，成功则伤害减半且不推离。

true-strike.en: Concentrate for 1 round to gain advantage on your first attack against the target on your next turn.
true-strike.zh-CN: 专注1轮；你下回合对目标的第一次攻击检定具有优势。

unseen-servant.en: Create an invisible, mindless servant for 1 hour to perform simple tasks within 60 feet; ritual.
unseen-servant.zh-CN: 创造隐形无心智仆役1小时，在60尺内执行简单任务；可作为仪式施展。

vicious-mockery.en: A creature that fails a Wisdom save takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
vicious-mockery.zh-CN: 生物感知豁免失败时受1d4心灵伤害，并在下一次攻击检定有劣势。

witch-bolt.en: Ranged spell attack for 1d12 lightning damage; while concentrating, use actions to repeat the damage if the link remains.
witch-bolt.zh-CN: 远程法术攻击造成1d12闪电伤害；专注维持连接时，可用动作重复造成伤害。
